title: Ancient Protector findings
description: Only advisories that affect an installed version. Ids must come from advisories.jsonl and inventory.jsonl.

advisories.description: Advisory ids (or their aliases) from advisories.jsonl, each once; the first is the primary one.

component.description: The affected component's id from inventory.jsonl, such as c12; it must be in the components of one of these advisories.

severity.description: Severity on this machine. Start from the advisory's score; if you change it, say why in evidence.

known_exploited.description: true when the advisory is in the CISA KEV catalog (known_exploited in advisories.jsonl).

confidence.description: confirmed: the installed version is in the affected range or you verified it; likely: probably affected but not certain.

evidence.description: What you checked: the installed version against the affected range, a setting, a file.

explanation.description: What the issue means for the user, in plain language.

commands.description: Exact shell commands, in order, each one line of printable ASCII; describe a path with other characters in steps. They are shown to the user and never run during a sweep.
